channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Woman critically injured after being struck by truck in Salt Lake City
item.description: A woman is in extreme critical condition after she was struck by a truck while walking in Salt Lake City early Monday.

item.title: Prosecutor warned Utah leaders, including Gov. Cox, to watch their words after Charlie Kirk killing
item.description: Court filings show a Utah County prosecutor warned Gov. Spencer Cox and other officials to be careful about public statements in the Tyler Robinson case — but sent no similar warning to Sen. Mike Lee, who has called for Robinson’s public execution.

item.title: No snow, no problem? Inside Utah’s high-stakes plan for the 2034 Olympics.
item.description: Can Utah successfully host the 2034 Olympics in a winter like this? Organizers say yes thanks to snowmaking, storage and salt. Hosting the Paralympics, though, might become an issue.

item.title: Utah students walk out to protest ICE tactics: ‘Fascism has got to go’
item.description: In Park City, hundreds of students joined in early morning chants in the cold. Walkouts have been announced around the state.

item.title: After months of anticipation, Hruska’s Kolaches set to open in new Sugar House spot
item.description: Hruska's Kolaches announced nearly a year ago that the bakery would move to a new location in Sugar House. The owners have set its opening for Tuesday.

item.title: Utah Jazz forward Lauri Markkanen thought he could have been an NBA All-Star. Did he get snubbed?
item.description: And at least one player from Utah felt they had a strong case to be named an NBA All-Star.

item.title: ‘It’s horrible’ — Utah snowpack hits worst levels on record
item.description: Is Utah losing its reputation for having the "Greatest Snow on Earth?"

item.title: ‘Decline to sign’ volunteers and GOP-paid signature gatherers clash during Prop 4 repeal effort
item.description: Utah Gov. Cox calls for respect for signature gatherers as ‘Decline to sign’ volunteers and GOP-paid gatherers clash during Prop 4 repeal effort.

item.title: Harsher than plea deal: Utah judge sends therapist to prison for recording patients undressing
item.description: The judge who sentenced Robert Dindinger worried that his former patients may question whether they can trust other therapists. “Will they turn away the very help they need because of you?” the judge wondered.

item.title: ‘Joseph Smith was Lincoln before Lincoln’ — Black college honors the LDS founder
item.description: A portrait of church founder Joseph Smith Jr. has been added to Morehouse College’s International Hall of Honor in Atlanta — to join paintings of Abraham Lincoln and Russell M. Nelson.
